en: A vintage sepia-toned postcard showing the interior of a large Gothic cathedral. The view looks down the central nave toward the ornate main altar, with high ribbed vaults, tall clustered columns, side aisles, wooden pews, and a suspended crucifix. Several people in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the central aisle. At the bottom margin, printed text identifies the location as Trento and describes the scene as the interior of the cathedral (Duomo).
